key_insight: Training language models on structured experimental evidence enabled stronger perovskite reasoning and guided a contact-material choice that outperformed the expert-preferred alternative.
engineering_relevance: Evidence-grounded AI could help engineers select interface materials and design experiments to improve perovskite solar-cell efficiency and thermal stability.
method: Reconstruct expert-calibrated evidence records from 4,035 articles, linking strategies, controls and observations to mechanisms.
Adapt OpenPerov using structured evidence and evaluate scientific reasoning on the 800-question PSM-Bench.
Refine selected answers with retrieved evidence and experimentally test a model-selected K-based self-assembled monolayer analogue.
evidence_signal: OpenPerov Flash ranked first among 13 closed-book systems; Pro improved Scientific Mastery from 87.6 to 89.1, while devices using the selected contact reached 27.05% efficiency and retained 96.74% after 1,000 hours of dark thermal ageing at 85°C.
watch_item: The reported device validation concerns one contact-design test, and dark thermal ageing does not establish operational stability under illumination.
paper_title: Evidence-grounded large language models guide perovskite solar cell design and optimization
